scope: overtaking (passing another vehicle, and being passed)

vocabulary.definition: Changing lanes to move past a slower vehicle, then returning to the original lane.
A designated area that allows pedestrians to safely cross roads where there are no traffic lights, marked by two white double parallel lines across the road with an X in each lane approaching it.

rules.title: No passing within 30 metres of a pedestrian crossover
rules.when: within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a PEDESTRIAN CROSSOVER, the PASSER MUST NOT pass any vehicle.
rules.note: Stated on two pages, both times as a prohibition.

rules.title: No passing left of a centreline 30 metres from a bridge, viaduct or tunnel
rules.when: within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, left of the centreline
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 metres of a bridge, viaduct or tunnel, left of the centreline, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.
rules.note: Stated on two pages, both times as a prohibition.

rules.title: No passing when approaching the crest of a hill or on a curve where vision is obstructed
rules.when: approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed
rules.statement: WHEN approaching the crest of a hill OR on a curve where vision of oncoming traffic is obstructed, the PASSER MUST NOT pass.
rules.note: Stated on two pages, both times as a prohibition.

rules.title: Steps for passing a vehicle
rules.action: use left-turn signal, check mirrors and blind spot, change lanes only after signalling, signal to return to original lane when far enough ahead, do not race if vehicle speeds up
rules.statement: WHEN passing a vehicle, the PASSER MUST use left-turn signal, check mirrors and blind spot, change lanes only after signalling, signal to return to original lane when far enough ahead, and do not race if the vehicle speeds up.

rules.title: Passing parked vehicles: watch for opening doors
rules.action: watch carefully for people opening doors or loading/unloading
rules.statement: WHEN passing parked vehicles, the PASSER MUST watch carefully for people opening doors or for doors opened to load and unload.

rules.title: Passing motorcycles, bicycles, limited-speed motorcycles and mopeds: do not take as an invitation to pass in the same lane
rules.when: passing a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped
rules.action: do not take the vehicle's movement to the left or right as an invitation to pass in the same lane
rules.statement: WHEN passing a motorcycle, bicycle, limited-speed motorcycle or moped, the PASSER SHOULD NOT take the vehicle's movement to the left or right as an invitation to pass in the same lane.

rules.title: Passing cyclists: minimum 1 metre distance
rules.action: keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical
rules.statement: WHEN passing a CYCLIST, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST keep at least 1 metre between the vehicle and the CYCLIST, where practical.
rules.penalty: A fine and two demerit points.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when 1 metre is impractical

rules.note: The same block states the penalty, and advises changing lanes to pass whenever possible; that is a separate ADVICE rule.

rules.title: Passing streetcars: on the right unless one-way
rules.action: pass on the right unless driving on a one-way road
rules.statement: WHEN passing a streetcar, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MUST pass on the right UNLESS driving on a one-way road.

rules.title: Passing on the right: only on multi-lane or one-way roads and when overtaking a streetcar or left-turning vehicle
rules.when: on a multi-lane road OR a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on a multi-lane road OR a one-way road OR overtaking a streetcar OR overtaking a left-turning vehicle, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle MAY pass on the right.

rules.title: Passing on the right: wait for vehicle ahead to move right before changing lanes
rules.when: passing on the right when the vehicle ahead is moving slower
rules.action: wait for the vehicle ahead to move to the right before changing lanes
rules.statement: WHEN passing on the right when the vehicle ahead is moving slower, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle SHOULD wait for the vehicle ahead to move to the right before changing lanes.

rules.title: Passing on the right: move to right lane when a truck wants to pass
rules.when: in the left most lane and a truck wants to pass
rules.action: move to the right-hand lane as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN in the left most lane and a truck wants to pass, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle SHOULD move to the right-hand lane as soon as possible.

rules.title: Being passed: move to right and let faster traffic pass
rules.action: move to the right and let the faster traffic pass in safety
rules.statement: WHEN faster traffic wants to pass, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle SHOULD move to the right and let the faster traffic pass in safety.

rules.title: Being passed: pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to right side when a truck passes on an undivided road
rules.when: being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane
rules.action: pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane
rules.statement: WHEN being passed on an undivided road where the passing driver has pulled into the opposite lane, the DRIVER of a motor vehicle SHOULD pay attention to oncoming traffic and move closer to the right side of the lane.
